summary: Frontend-only Playwright e2e of Probability Dungeon. Title→Playing transition, HUD (3 hearts, ROOM 1/8), 512x384 canvas, WASD/Arrow movement, 'o' attack, room lock, robot proximity, Quiz dialog (question + 4 options), Exit-once close, numeric tab+input+submit, multi-choice answer + feedback, and gameover-screen all verified. Robot destroy-on-2nd-Exit could not be browser-verified because the player was killed by skeletons before re-approach, but the code path (handleQuizExit increments exitClicks; >=2 sets robot.destroyed=true) is correct.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify in browser because skeletons kill player before re-approach. After first Exit click, the 14px anti-retrigger bump plus aggressive skeleton chasing makes re-approach without dying very hard during automated test. Code logic (robot.exitClicks>=2 -> destroyed=true) is correct; recommend manual verification or temporarily disabling skeletons for QA path.

issues: Console warning: 'Canvas2D: Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with the willReadFrequently attribute set to true.' Non-blocking but adds noise; consider passing {willReadFrequently:true} to getContext('2d') if any sprite drawer reads pixels.

action_items: Consider giving the player brief invulnerability or spawning skeletons farther from the entrance; currently first-room skeletons can kill the player in <5s of idle, blocking re-approach to robots in QA.
Optionally suppress the willReadFrequently Canvas2D console warning by setting the context option.
Manually verify that clicking Exit twice on the same robot removes it from the canvas (sfxKill should play and proximity should no longer reopen the dialog).
critical_code_review_comments: ProbabilityDungeon.jsx is ~700 lines; consider splitting room-build / loop / render into separate modules.

startLoop is restarted on every quiz.open or screen change (useEffect dep). This works but the closure over quiz.open is the only reason; refactor to read quiz state via stateRef to avoid re-creating the RAF loop.
sfxStep() is called every frame while moving (no throttle) — may produce audio artifacts; throttle to e.g. 180ms.
After first Exit, player.x/y is bumped by 14px which can push player into a wall corner; bumpback should be clamped to room bounds.
Numeric feedback message uses question.numeric.toUpperCase() unconditionally; will throw if question.numeric is undefined for any entry — add guard.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (12/13 verified items pass; 1 item — robot destroy on 2nd Exit — unverifiable due to skeleton lethality, code path is correct)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use Playwright with keyboard.down('ArrowRight')+keyboard.down('ArrowUp') for ~2-4s after pressing start to reach the upper robot at (192,64). The quiz dialog has data-testid='quiz-dialog'. Skeletons kill the player quickly (3 hearts, contact damage 1 per 700ms iframe) — to verify 2nd-Exit destroy you may need to attack with rapid 'o' presses while moving. Game-over and victory screens use data-testid='gameover-screen'/'victory-screen' with 'restart-btn'.
rca of the issue: Robot 2nd-Exit destroy not browser-verifiable: after handleQuizExit closes the dialog, the player is bumped only 14px away from the robot. While quiz is closed, normal game logic resumes; skeletons (which were chasing during the 'frozen during quiz' period) are now adjacent to the player and deal contact damage every 700ms, killing the player before they can re-cross the 40px ROBOT_PROXIMITY_PX threshold to re-trigger the dialog. Mitigation: extend iframes after quiz close (e.g., player.iframesUntil = st.time + 1200) so player has time to re-approach robot, or freeze skeletons while quiz is open.
